jobDescription: The payments operations unit of a commercial bank reconciles the bank's nostro accounts with its correspondent banks every day and chases the breaks that stay unmatched. The analyst runs the daily matching cycle in the reconciliation tool, investigates and clears breaks with correspondents, tunes the auto-matching rules through the controlled change process and prepares the open-items position for the operations risk committee each month. Reductions in open items are reported from the tool's month-end ageing reports. The analyst works alongside the treasury desk, the card-scheme settlement team and the operations risk function.
requirements: Runs the daily nostro reconciliation cycle in a reconciliation tool.
Investigates and clears unmatched items with correspondent banks within the escalation timelines.
Tunes auto-matching rules through a controlled change process with test evidence.
Shows a measured reduction in aged open items from month-end reports.
Prepares the monthly open-items report for the operations risk committee and presents it at the meeting.

evidence.text: Ran the daily matching cycle for 38 nostro accounts at Penhallow Commercial Bank in the reconciliation tool, starting from the overnight statement load.
Investigated unmatched items by raising queries with correspondent banks over SWIFT and escalated anything open for more than 10 days to the team supervisor, as the escalation procedure required.
Rewrote six auto-matching rules for card-scheme settlement entries; each change went through the change board with test results from the tool's rule simulator.
Open items older than 30 days across the 38 accounts fell from 1,146 at the end of March 2023 to 287 at the end of September 2023, according to the tool's month-end ageing reports.
Drafted the monthly open-items paper for the operations risk committee, with ageing buckets and commentary on the largest breaks.

Work sample: the month-end ageing reports for March and September 2023 exported from the reconciliation tool (1,146 and 287 items over 30 days), together with the change-board tickets for the six matching rules and the date each rule went into use.
HR verification note: the candidate's employment at Penhallow Commercial Bank (October 2020 to the present, Payments Operations Analyst) was confirmed through the bank's employment verification line.
Recruiter logistics note: the candidate currently works three office days a week and asked whether this role follows the same pattern.
